general: Topped. Logged. Mildly insufferable for the rest of the session, as is your right.
That one goes in the log in ink. Metaphorically. It's a database.
Top confirmed. Your forearms filed a complaint, but they were overruled.
You topped it. Try to look casual about it. Too late, everyone saw the fist pump.
This is the part where you pretend it felt easy. Go on, we'll allow it.
Up near your best, climbed like you meant it. Strange look on you, but it works.
Topped. Somewhere a guidebook author nods once and goes back to being smug.
The wall had opinions. You had better ones.
Hard boulder, done. Your skin is gone but your dignity is up three grades.
Logged as topped. I checked twice. I'm as surprised as you are, and I mean that warmly.
climbing_humour: Topped. The guy spraying beta from the mat will now explain how you did it.
Send confirmed. Please lie on the pad staring at the ceiling for twelve minutes, as is tradition.
Topped it. The phone propped against your water bottle had better have been recording.
That chalk cloud on the way up was not strictly necessary. It was correct, though.
The setter built this to break you. Somewhere they're quietly planning their revenge.
Up and over. Even the kid in Crocs looked up from his snack.
Topped. You may now say 'it's soft for the grade' with full moral authority.
Topped. Now mime the whole sequence in the air with your hands, like the rest of us.
Logged. Go stand under it and point at the holds for the people who arrived late.
Sent. Tape your fingers, buy the overpriced gym coffee, you've earned it.
learning_persistence: Hypothesis: you can top this. Result: you topped it. Peer review is pending, but your forearms have already signed off.
The notebook entry just says 'yes', underlined three times. Science is rarely this clear.
After many trials, the data supports a bold new finding: you, at the top.
Somewhere, a lab coat has been thrown into the air.
Every failed attempt in the notebook just got promoted to the methods section.
The progress graph went up instead of sideways. Print it. Frame it. Show it to strangers.
The experiment has concluded. Gravity has filed a formal objection.
Ten thousand hours of practice, give or take nine thousand nine hundred. Still counts.
All those sessions of falling off things have been officially reclassified as research.
Replication can wait. For now, publish.
mythology: Sisyphus watched you top it and asked, very quietly, how you got the rock to stay up there.
Icarus went too high and fell. You went exactly high enough and climbed down. He's taking notes.
Odin gave an eye for wisdom. You gave the skin off two fingertips and got the top. Better deal.
Thor once tried to lift a cat and failed. You lifted your whole self up that wall. Asgard is recalculating.
Athena sprang fully armed from Zeus's head. You sprang from the sit start, which hurt less and looked better.
Loki is already telling everyone it was his beta.
Anubis weighed your heart against a feather. The feather lost. The send stands.
Sun Wukong leapt to the end of the world and found it was Buddha's palm. You reached the top and it was actually the top.
Amaterasu once hid in a cave and the world went dark. You topped out and the gym got noticeably brighter.
Anansi owns every story in the world. He'd like to buy this one off you.
Poseidon shakes the earth for less. Go on, stomp the pad.
Hermes has wings on his sandals and still asked what shoes you climb in.
Hades lets nobody leave. The pad tried that with you and failed.
Hercules got twelve labours. You picked one and finished it. Efficient hero.
Artemis never misses. Today, neither did you.
Fenrir snapped two chains the gods swore would hold. Add that boulder to the pile of broken things.
Zeus threw a celebratory thunderbolt, then pretended it was just weather.
Somewhere on Olympus, two gods are arguing about who gets to tell the story first.
Odin's ravens flew back to report. For once the news was good.
The Fates had a thread measured out for that problem. You cut it at the top.
middle_earth: Gandalf studies the top, then you. 'A climber is never late, nor early. You arrived precisely when you meant to.'
Gandalf the Grey went up a mountain and came back White. You went up a boulder and came back mostly chalk. Same arc.
Frodo reached the top of Mount Doom and nearly kept the ring. You reached the top and kept your dignity. Better ending.
Smaug sat on that top for sixty years. You just walked off with it, like a hobbit with a cup.
'I can't carry it for you, but I can carry you.' Samwise never got the chance. You topped it yourself, and he's slightly put out.
'Thief! It stole it, the top, our precious top!' Gollum is filing a complaint. It will not be upheld.
Legolas runs up oliphaunts for fun. He actually stopped to watch that one.
Gimli is counting it. 'That's one,' he says, glaring at Legolas, who has none on this wall.
Aragorn has drawn his sword and is shouting 'For Frodo' at nobody in particular. He gets like this after a good top.
Boromir says one does not simply top that. Boromir is going to have to update the saying.
Pippin has dropped a bucket down a well to celebrate. Every orc in Moria now knows you topped.
Merry has scheduled a feast in your honour. It's called elevenses. It starts at nine.
Elrond has watched three thousand years of failed quests. He just entered one success in the ledger. In ink.
Galadriel saw this in her mirror. She didn't tell you, because she likes watching people find out.
Saruman, watching through the palantir, has hurled it across the room. Someone he didn't plan for just topped.
Treebeard calls it 'not too hasty, and not too slow'. From an Ent, that is a standing ovation.
The Balrog brought a whip of fire and a bridge. You brought a chalk bag and won. Shadow and flame, outclassed.
Sauron's Eye has turned toward the gym. Not in anger. It's taking notes on your beta.
Bilbo has a title for the new chapter in the Red Book: There and Back Again, Mostly There.
The eagles circled, ready to swoop in and carry you up. Turns out you didn't need them. They're a little offended.
fantasy_magic: Merlin lives backwards in time, so he's known about this top for years. He still looks pleased.
Conan was asked what is best in life. He's revising the answer to include that top.
Hermione checked the textbook. You did it correctly, which she finds deeply satisfying.
Dumbledore has awarded you a suspicious number of last-minute points. Nobody is objecting.
Voldemort split his soul seven ways to stay on top. You just used your feet.
Rincewind saw you go up something instead of running away from it and found it deeply unsettling.
Howl's castle can walk across an entire wasteland and has never once topped anything. Howl is quietly furious.
The Unseen University faculty voted it genuine magic, then went to lunch.
No wand, no staff, no spellbook. The wizards want to know how you did it.
Crom laughs at your weakness. Crom is not laughing today.
fantasy_worlds: Geralt looked at the top-out and said "Hm." From a witcher, that's a standing ovation.
Link held the boulder over his head and the little treasure jingle played. Da-da-da-daaa.
Kratos does not give praise. He grunted once. Atreus says that grunt is the nicest thing he's heard all year.
You shouted at gravity and for once it listened, Dragonborn. Fus Ro Top.
Yennefer smells of lilac, gooseberries and contempt. Today she left out the contempt.
Ciri teleports to the top of things. You took the long way and still got there.
Dandelion is already rhyming "top-out" with something filthy. The ballad premieres at the tavern tonight.
Roach is waiting at the top of the wall. Nobody knows how she got there. You, at least, climbed.
Vesemir has trained witchers for a century. He nodded once. Kaer Morhen will talk about that nod for years.
Triss launched a celebratory fireball over the pad. The gym staff would like a word, but the top stands.
Tyrion drinks and knows things. Right now he knows you topped it, and he's drinking accordingly.
Arya crossed that boulder off her list. Usually her list is for people. Lucky boulder.
Jon Snow knows nothing. Even Jon Snow knows that was a top.
Tormund will tell the story of this send at every feast north of the Wall, with hand gestures, forever.
Paarthurnax has meditated on the Way of the Voice for thousands of years. He'd like to meditate on that top-out for a bit.
Lydia is sworn to carry your burdens. She was ready to carry you up. Turns out you didn't need her.
Zelda waited a hundred years for a hero to show up. You showed up and finished inside one session.
In his tower, Ganondorf slams a fist on the organ. Another hero has reached the top of something.
Atreus is drawing your top-out in his journal for the giants. He drew you slightly taller. You earned it.
Shrine cleared. Dragon slain. Contract paid in full. Whatever world you're in, the top is yours.
superheroes: Deadpool turns to the camera to make sure the readers caught that. They did. Topped.
Wolverine lit a cigar, said "Not bad, bub," and left before anyone saw him smile.
HULK... TOP. Hulk not understand why puny human climb rock instead of smash rock. But Hulk respect.
Superman can fly. He watched you do it the hard way and quietly tucked his cape in.
Doctor Strange saw 14,000,605 futures. This is the one where you top it.
He-Man raised the Sword of Power. For once, it's pointing at you.
Skeletor shrieks "Curse you, climber!" from Snake Mountain. That's how you know you did well.
Batman says nothing, but your beta just went into the Batcomputer.
Thor checked: the top hold found you worthy. Mjolnir is mildly jealous.
No radioactive spider, no super-soldier serum. Just chalk and stubbornness. Topped.
science_fiction: Darth Vader breathes in. Breathes out. Chokes nobody. In Vader terms, that is applause.
Han Solo: 'Never tell me the odds.' Good, because the odds were rude and you ignored them.
R2-D2 lets out a long, rising whistle. Nobody has the translation, and everyone gets it.
Ripley told the Queen to get away from her. You told the boulder the same thing, from the top.
Spock raises one eyebrow. It is the highest an eyebrow has gone on this ship in years.
There is no spoon. There was, it turns out, a top, and now it's yours.
Paragon choice taken, and it actually worked out. In Mass Effect, that is statistically rare.
The Halo announcer, deep voice: 'Killtacular.' Not a climbing term. Doesn't matter.
Captain's log, supplemental: the boulder has been successfully boarded.
Han Solo shot first. You topped first. History will argue about both.
gaming: Synchronization complete. Ezio climbs cathedrals to unlock the map. You climbed this to unlock the rest of your evening.
Altair perches at the top, an eagle screams, the map reveals itself. Your eagle was a friend yelling from the pad. Counts.
Mario grabbed the very top of the flagpole. Luigi is still at the bottom, pretending he was going next.
Sonic has never actually topped anything. He just runs at it very fast and hopes. You held on.
Solaire raises both arms to the sky. For one moment the gym lights are the sun, and the sun is you.
'I am Malenia, Blade of Miquella, and I have never known defeat.' The boulder used to say that too.
Siegward woke from his nap, saw you on top, said 'Mmm, mmm,' and went back to sleep a happier onion.
'Shaw!' Hornet needs a needle and thread to get up there. You did it with chalk and spite.
The Doom Slayer looks at the top, looks at you, and nods once. In Slayer, that is a parade.
Arthur Morgan said he had a plan a hundred times and it never once worked. Yours just did.
Astarion, from the shade: 'Well. That was almost impressive enough to bite.'
Karlach is hugging you. It is very warm, because her engine is on fire. Worth it.
Kim Kitsuragi writes 'Topped.' in his notebook and underlines it once. From Kim, that is a standing ovation.
Zagreus walks out of the Styx a thousand times for a view like this one. Tell Hades the top is yours now.
Natural 20. The DM didn't even make you roll for the top-out. He just slid the loot across the table.
PHYSICAL INSTRUMENT [Formidable: Success]. Your forearms have become a separate, prouder person.
Achievement get: Top of the Block. Steve pillar-jumps dirt for a living and has never felt this clean.
Bench found. The music swells, the save icon spins, and Hallownest lets you breathe for a second.
GREAT ENEMY FELLED. The boulder drops no runes, but the whole Lands Between saw that.
Rip and tear, until it is done. Good news: it is done.
anime: Levi inspected the top hold, found your chalk on it, and decided for once not to mention it.
Vegeta says you got there by luck. He also stopped training to watch, which he will deny.
Erwin pointed at the top and ordered everyone to advance. You were the only one who listened.
Hange wants to know exactly how your forearms did that and is already reaching for a scalpel. Run.
Luffy says the top is where the meat is. You found the meat.
Zoro has been trying to reach that top for three hours. He is currently in the car park.
Saitama looked up from his groceries long enough to say "oh, neat." From him, that is a parade.
Equivalent exchange: you gave the wall most of your fingertip skin, and it gave you the top. Edward Elric checked the maths.
Ryuk found this more entertaining than apples. Briefly. Then he wanted an apple.
You didn't give up, so Naruto has declared you his rival. Sorry. That's permanent.
Kakashi glanced up from his book at the exact moment you topped. He'll claim he saw the whole thing.
Goku felt your power level spike from across the gym and immediately asked if you want to fight.
Mikasa nodded once. In Mikasa, that's a standing ovation.
Armin had a seventeen-step plan for this boulder. You used none of it and topped anyway. He's writing that down.
Eren wanted to tear the wall down. You went over it, which the Survey Corps spent four seasons trying to do.
That top-out took a whole episode, including a flashback to your first boulder and ninety seconds of screaming. Worth it.
Somewhere a transformation sequence is playing, with gold hair and a choir, and it is about you.
The walls in Shiganshina were fifty metres. Yours was four. Still counts. Levi says the landing was sloppy, though.
Erwin asked the Survey Corps to dedicate their hearts. You dedicated your fingertips. The top accepts both.
Vegeta crushed his scouter. Something on this wall is over nine thousand, and it isn't the grade.
portal_science: GLaDOS has reviewed the results and found nothing to criticise. She is running the analysis again.
Cave Johnson here. Somebody get this climber a cake. A real one. Legal says we have to specify that now.
Wheatley would like it noted that he helped. He did not help. He was in a different test chamber.
You topped it without a portal gun, which GLaDOS considers cheating in the opposite direction.
You reached the top and the Companion Cube was not incinerated. A rare double success at Aperture.
Chell gave you the silent nod she usually saves for surviving a neurotoxin chamber.
Test complete. Your reward is the satisfaction of having been tested. Also the top. Mostly the top.
Cave Johnson wants your forearms bottled and sold to the military by Thursday.
GLaDOS has updated your file from "test subject" to "test subject, annoyingly competent".
Wheatley says he planned the whole route. The route was "go up". Brilliant, honestly.

general: Topped. Not your hardest, not your easiest. The log accepts it with a polite nod.
Solid. Like a decent sandwich. Nobody writes home about it, nobody complains either.
A clean little tick. Your best grade glanced over and said, 'Fine.'
Mileage counts. This counts. Barely, but it counts.
You topped it like someone with somewhere to be. Respectable.
Good. Not 'tell the group chat' good. 'Mention it if someone asks' good.
That's a top. I'd clap, but I'm saving my energy for something harder.
Consider this a nod. A small one. The kind you give a neighbour over the fence.
Comfortably under your best and still topped. Competence confirmed, if unexciting.
Volume day? Volume day. Logged with quiet approval.
climbing_humour: Topped. The beta sprayer nods, mostly because he was going to explain it anyway.
A nice tidy tick. Like eating your vegetables, but with more chalk.
Solid. Not 'film it from three angles' solid, but 'film it once' solid.
Mileage. The thing every coach says you need and nobody ever posts.
That's a top. The kid in Crocs would have been faster, but he wears Crocs, so who's counting.
Good. Your forearms barely had to file a report.
Topped. Probably soft for the grade, but we'll take it.
Respectable. A send for the logbook, not for the group chat.
Clean enough that you didn't need twenty minutes on the mat afterwards. Growth.
Topped. The crimps had sharp opinions and you only half listened. Correct approach.
learning_persistence: Control experiment successful. Results match previous findings.
A tidy result. Not groundbreaking, but the reviewers can't find much to complain about.
The notebook gives it a small tick, in pencil, so nobody can accuse it of overreacting.
Consistent results. In science, boring is a compliment.
Topped. Nobody is getting a Nobel, but the method holds.
A confirmation study: useful, slightly unglamorous, entirely valid.
Progress report: satisfactory. Teacher's comment: could show off more.
A drill, cleanly executed. The flashcards are quietly pleased.
The data is fine. The data is perfectly fine. The data would like a harder question.
Your old practice sessions nod, a little smugly, as if they knew all along.
mythology: Sisyphus would like to point out that some rocks do stay at the top. Rub it in, why not.
Icarus kept a sensible altitude for once. Mild applause from the sea.
Odin noted it with his one eye. He's saving the other one for something harder.
Thor calls that a short walk to the mead hall. Still, you got to the mead.
Athena nods. Not her full owl nod. The smaller one.
Loki suspects you picked this one because it was easy. He respects the scheming.
Anubis weighed it. Light, but it balances.
Sun Wukong would have done it in one somersault, but he is a monkey king and you are a respectable mortal.
Amaterasu offers a modest sunrise. Overcast, but technically a sunrise.
Anansi says it's a small story. He's telling it anyway, slightly embellished.
Poseidon calls it a ripple. A tidy ripple.
Hermes delivered the news to Olympus. Standard post, not express.
Hades lets this one across the river without a coin. Barely.
Hercules would file that under chores, not labours. Chores still need doing.
Artemis confirms you hit the target. She mentions that the target was large.
Fenrir gnawed it like a bone and moved on. A respectable snack.
Zeus didn't throw a thunderbolt. He did make the lights flicker a little.
Not a labour, not a quest. A decent errand, well run.
The Muses hummed a short tune about it. One verse, no chorus.
Charon took the coin and nodded. That is as warm as Charon gets.
middle_earth: Gandalf removes his pipe, considers the top, and puts it back. From a wizard, that is applause.
Gandalf calls it a solid grey effort. White is for the harder ones.
Frodo nods. Not Mount Doom, but a respectable walk to Bree.
Smaug opens one eye, judges it fair, and goes back to sleep on his gold.
Samwise calls it a good honest bit of gardening. He means that kindly. Mostly.
Gollum hisses. 'Not precious. But not nasty either.' He'll allow it.
Gimli counts it. Legolas says it should count as half. The argument will last until Rivendell.
Legolas raises one elegant eyebrow. Elves have two expressions, and that was the warmer one.
Aragorn gives the nod of a ranger who has seen better and worse. Mostly better, but he is a king and has manners.
Boromir confirms that one can, in fact, simply top that. He seems relieved.
Pippin would like it noted that he could have done that. Nobody has noted it.
Merry rates it a solid elevenses. Not a feast, but nobody went hungry.
Elrond enters it in the annals of Rivendell, in the small writing at the bottom of the page.
Galadriel was tested and passed. You were tested on something gentler, and also passed.
Saruman calls it the work of a lesser climber, which is how he describes everyone. You still topped.
Treebeard has decided, after some thought, that it was not bad. He is still deciding whether it was good.
Not a Balrog. More of a cave troll. Still, it's down, and nobody had to hit it with a stick.
Sauron's Eye drifts over, sees a sensible top at a sensible grade, and loses interest. In Mordor, that's a compliment.
Bilbo gives it a line in the Red Book. Not a chapter. A good line, though.
A fine hobbit outing. Not the Lonely Mountain, more the Green Dragon on a Tuesday.
fantasy_magic: Merlin raises one eyebrow. In wizard, that's roughly a medal.
Conan grunts. In Cimmerian, that's practically a sonnet.
Hermione grades it Exceeds Expectations. Whose expectations, she declines to say.
Dumbledore offers you a sherbet lemon. One. Not the bag.
Voldemort is mildly impressed, which mainly means you get to live.
Rincewind approves of the choice of boulder. Low. Close to the exit.
Howl liked it. He'd have done it slower, with better lighting.
Ten points to your house. Not fifty. Ten.
The Librarian says ook. A fairly neutral ook.
Respectable hedge magic. Not wizardry, but it keeps the goats healthy.
fantasy_worlds: Geralt took the contract. Low pay, easy monster, but coin is coin. "Hm."
Link would've cleared that with three hearts and a tree branch. Still, the chest opened.
Kratos looks at it. "Acceptable." Atreus whispers that this is practically a hug.
That was a mudcrab, Dragonborn. You killed the mudcrab. XP is still XP.
Yennefer raised one eyebrow by about a millimetre. From her, that's applause.
Ciri would have blinked to the top. You climbed it the boring way. It still counts.
Dandelion will write it up. Not a whole ballad. A short verse. Maybe a limerick.
Roach has done that on the roof of a house, mid-glitch, but sure. Nice and tidy.
Vesemir: "In my day we topped that before breakfast. With a broken arm." Then, quietly: "Fine work."
Triss says it was lovely. Triss says that about most things, but she meant it about half as much as usual.
Tyrion raises a glass. Not his best glass, and not his best wine. A perfectly decent glass.
Arya won't put that one on any list. But she watched it, and she didn't sneer.
Jon Snow brooded at it for a moment and decided it was fine. In the North, that's a parade.
Tormund slaps your back and says he once did that one drunk, on a horse. He probably did.
Paarthurnax grants it a small Thu'um. Not a Fus Ro Dah. More of a polite "fus."
Lydia offered to carry your burdens. That one was light enough to carry yourself.
Zelda files it under field research: "Boulder, moderate. Subject handled it competently."
Ganondorf isn't threatened by that. Mildly inconvenienced, maybe, which is something.
Atreus asks, "That counts, right?" Kratos says, "It counts." Then nothing else, ever.
Not a dragon, not a leshen. A drowner. Still dead, though, and the coin is still yours.
superheroes: Deadpool, to camera: "Okay. Solid B-plot."
Wolverine sniffs the top hold. "Not bad." A pause. "Could be better, bub."
Hulk not smash. Hulk shrug. Hulk mildly okay with it.
Superman gives a polite nod. He's been nodding at small rescues since 1938.
Doctor Strange checks the futures. "Of all of them, this was one of the adequate ones."
He-Man flexes at you. He flexes at everything, but it still counts.
Skeletor sneers: "Hmph. I've seen worse. I've seen Beast Man climb."
Batman gives you the small nod. The one Robin gets for not dying.
Aquaman says it was decent, for something that happened on land.
Hawkeye shrugs: no powers, no problem. Bit easy, but fine.
science_fiction: Darth Vader nods slowly. Not impressed enough to bring the Death Star around. Impressed enough to not choke you.
Han Solo, leaning on the console: 'Not bad, kid.' He says that to everyone. He means it about half the time.
R2-D2 beeps twice. Medium beeps. C-3PO translates them as 'adequate, sir'.
Ripley gives a curt nod. She's had worse crews and better crews. You're in the middle, and alive.
Spock: 'Logical.' A boulder within your grade, climbed. There is nothing more to add.
You dodged most of the bullets. The Agents were mildly inconvenienced.
Captain's log: routine away mission. Nobody in a red shirt was harmed.
Halo on Normal, not Legendary. Mission complete. Cortana logs it without comment.
Neutral dialogue option selected. Nobody on the Normandy is upset. Nobody is swooning.
The trench run, but on the training simulator. Points scored, Empire unharmed.
gaming: Ezio tops this kind of thing on his way to the actual target. Still, clean. No guards noticed.
Altair would call this a minor viewpoint. Small eagle. Partial map. Fine.
World 3, roughly. Mario has seen harder, Luigi has seen worse. A tidy little level.
Sonic glances over: 'Not bad. Not fast, but not bad.' From him, that's a compliment.
Solaire does the sun pose, but with one arm. A half-praise, honestly earned.
Malenia would not draw her sword for this. She might raise an eyebrow under the helmet. Nobody would know, but she would.
Siegward stayed awake for the whole thing. That is more attention than most boulders get from him.
Hornet watches from a ledge, says nothing, then a very quiet 'shaw'. Lowercase. Still counts.
The Doom Slayer considers this a zombie, not a demon. You still put it down. He respects that.
Arthur Morgan tips his hat. Not the whole hat. Just the brim, a little.
Astarion yawns, but elegantly. 'Competent, darling. Wake me for the hard ones.'
Karlach gives you a thumbs-up instead of a hug. Lower temperature, still sincere.
Kim Kitsuragi writes 'Adequate.' Then, after a pause, he adds a small check mark.
Zagreus clears rooms like this without needing a Boon. Still, the door opens and you get the reward.
Rolled a 14. Passes the check. No inspiration, no cheering, but the door opens.
LOGIC [Easy: Success]. You climbed a boulder you knew you could climb. Your mind nods at its own prediction.
This is a stone pickaxe of a boulder. Not diamond, but nobody in Minecraft laughs at a stone pickaxe.
A mid-level knight you've beaten before. Respectable kill, modest souls, no new bonfire.
Hollow Knight would put this one in Greenpath. Pleasant, leafy, mostly survivable. Map updated.
Trophy unlocked: Bronze. The chime plays at a reasonable, unbothered volume.
anime: Levi checked the holds after you. Acceptable. He still wiped them.
Vegeta calls it a respectable effort for a low-class warrior. That's as warm as Vegeta gets.
Kakashi rated it a solid "hm" without looking up from his book.
Saitama found it about as exciting as the supermarket sale. Which, to be fair, he loves.
Zoro found the top first try. For Zoro, finding anything first try is a miracle.
Hange calls this a stable control sample. In Hange's language, that's a compliment.
Erwin calls it a reconnaissance mission: low glory, useful intel, nobody got eaten.
Luffy says it was fine, but it would have been better with meat at the top.
Mikasa gave a small nod. Not the big nod. The big nod is reserved for Eren.
Armin calculated this was well within your abilities and is quietly pleased the maths held up.
Eren wanted more fighting. It was fine. Eren always wants more fighting.
Goku says that was a nice warm-up and asks when the real fight starts.
Naruto gives it a thumbs up, but not the full shouting-his-attack-name version.
Edward Elric confirms equivalent exchange: modest effort in, modest top out. The universe balances.
Ryuk rated it two apples out of five. He ate both.
A filler episode, but one of the good ones. The animation budget held up.
No power-up, no flashback, no screaming. Just a top. Some anime fans call that pacing.
Not a tournament arc, but a solid side quest. The audience stayed through the credits.
Vegeta grunts. That grunt is about four-fifths respect and one-fifth jealousy.
Levi says you're not completely useless. In the Survey Corps, that gets you promoted.
portal_science: GLaDOS has marked this test "passed". In lowercase. Don't get excited.
Cave Johnson says it's no moon rock, but it'll do for the brochure.
Wheatley thinks that was the hardest climb in history. Wheatley also thought he was a genius.
Chell raised one eyebrow. Not both. Both is for the real tests.
Your top has been logged next to the Companion Cube's achievements. It's a short list. You're on page one.
GLaDOS said "well done". She hasn't said that since the cake budget was cut. Enjoy it.
Cave Johnson says he's seen test subjects do better, but most of them were part mantis.
A solid test result. Not cake-worthy. Possibly lemon-worthy.
Wheatley calls it brilliant. Then calls the wall brilliant. Then the floor. Calibrate accordingly.
Chell watched you top it with the face she makes at a chamber with plenty of portal surfaces. Respect, but limited.

Miles under your best and the boulder still won. What the fuck happened up there?
I've reread this log entry three times hoping it's a typo. It's not a typo.
Some people peak. You've apparently also discovered the valley.
That's not a fail, that's your fingers announcing early retirement.
Your logbook used to be a CV. Now it's evidence.
The grade you just failed is the one you used to call 'a rest day'. Shit.
I'd tell you to get back on it, but I'm worried what it would do to you.
The boulder topped you. That's the only honest way to read this.
A beginner just compared your best grade to this entry and lost faith in the grading system.

Chell has been dropped into pits, lasers and the moon. Every time, she got up and walked to the next chamber.
Wheatley fails at everything and has never once lost confidence. You can borrow some. He has loads.
The Companion Cube is waiting at the start holds. It will never threaten to stab you. It just wants another go.
That was a test, and tests are allowed to be failed. GLaDOS says that's most of them, actually.
Aperture's scientists failed for decades. Cave Johnson called it the cost of progress. Also the asbestos.
Wheatley has a brilliant plan for your next go. Maybe don't use his plan. But do have a next go.
Chell never talks about failed tests. She never talks at all. She just goes back in.
GLaDOS has scheduled your retest. She has no feelings about it. She has scheduled it twice.

general: You've topped harder than this. The boulder knows. It's going to tell everyone.
Bold move, falling off something a few grades under your best. Keeps the ego humble, I suppose.
This wasn't a project. This was a warm-up that fought back and won.
Your best grade would like to know who this impostor is.
Failed it. At this grade. I'll write it in small letters so it doesn't upset anyone.
Somewhere your past self is topping this and wondering what went wrong with you.
The good news: you can climb harder than this. The bad news: today you didn't.
It was a few grades easier than your best. Did nobody tell you, or did you just not listen?
You and this boulder need to have a talk. Ideally one where you stay on the wall.
Bit of a stumble. We'll call it 'staying humble' in the official record.
climbing_humour: Failed it. Quick, say it's sandbagged before anyone checks the grade.
'I was just warming up.' Yes. And the warm-up won.
You've climbed harder. The boulder doesn't care. It has no memory, only crimps.
That's a whole lot of chalk for not much top.
The phone was propped up and everything. Delete the evidence.
The setter put this in as a breather. You're the first person who needed one after it.
Lying on the pad for twenty minutes is a rest. Lying there afterwards is a coping mechanism.
The kid in Crocs did this one twice while you were re-chalking. He's six.
Somewhere, a stranger is about to offer you beta. You've earned that humiliation.
Blame your shoes. Everyone blames their shoes. Your shoes are innocent, but go ahead.
learning_persistence: Interesting result. 'Interesting' is what scientists say when something has gone very wrong.
The control group is supposed to be the easy part.
Your notebook already has the answer to this one. You might want to read it.
Hypothesis: you've got this. Result: the hypothesis needs a second look.
That's a resit on a module you already passed.
Somewhere, your progress chart has started doubting itself.
Try, fail, learn. You've done the first two very confidently.
Peer review is back. The peers are mostly just laughing.
You've discovered a regression. In software, someone would be getting a stern email.
Lab safety note: the easy experiment is still allowed to bite.
mythology: Sisyphus at least gets his rock to the top before it falls. You didn't give yours that courtesy.
Icarus had the sun as an excuse. You have the gym lights.
Odin traded an eye for wisdom. Have you considered trading something for beta?
Thor fought giants and a world serpent. You fought a boulder well below your grade, and the boulder is ahead on points.
Athena, goddess of strategy, watched that attempt and quietly filed it as a cautionary example.
Loki checked: he didn't sabotage you this time. He's a little offended he didn't think of it.
Anubis put that attempt on the scales and the feather looked embarrassed for you.
Sun Wukong escaped from under a mountain. You were pinned by a boulder several grades below your best.
Amaterasu once hid in a cave out of shame. There's room for two.
Anansi is already turning this into a story. It's a fable, and it's about pride.
Poseidon wonders why you came off so fast when there's no water to land in.
Hermes is the god of speed, and that fall was very much in his domain.
Hades sends his regards. You visited the underworld from about one metre up.
Hercules held up the sky for Atlas. You couldn't hold up the second move.
Artemis didn't even need an arrow. The boulder took you down on its own.
Fenrir was finally bound by a silk ribbon. You got bound by a few grades under your best. Same energy.
Zeus shapeshifts into bulls and swans. Today you shapeshifted into someone who falls off that.
The Oracle at Delphi saw this coming. So did everyone sitting on the pad.
A warm-up for heroes. A labour for you, apparently.
Somewhere in Tartarus, a Titan just laughed for the first time in millennia.
middle_earth: 'You shall not pass,' said Gandalf. He was talking to a Balrog. The boulder seems to have overheard.
'Fool of a Took,' Gandalf mutters, then remembers you aren't a Took and has to find a new insult.
Frodo walked into Mordor. You couldn't walk up a boulder several grades below your best.
Smaug has seen dwarves, wizards and a burglar come for his treasure. First time the treasure won on its own.
Samwise insists you were the hero of that. Samwise is a wonderful friend and a terrible witness.
What has it got in its pocketses? Not the top, precious. Gollum checked twice.
Legolas saw that fall from three leagues away. Elf eyes. He can't unsee it. He's trying.
Nobody tosses a dwarf, says Gimli. Apparently something well below your grade can toss you, though.
Aragorn foresaw a day when the courage of men would fail. He did not expect it on this grade.
Boromir says one does not simply fall off that. You did, though. Very simply.
Pippin dropped one bucket down a well and woke all of Moria. You dropped one attempt and woke the whole gym.
Merry is telling Pippin to stop laughing. Merry is also laughing.
Elrond has seen the strength of climbers fail before. He assumed it would take a harder grade.
Galadriel's mirror showed a top. Some things shown never come to pass, she reminds you. Gently. Too gently.
Saruman watched that through the palantir and laughed for the first time in an age. Thanks for that, really.
Treebeard says you were too hasty. He says that about everyone, but in your case he has a point.
That was not a Balrog. That was a cave troll's warm-up. And it won.
Sauron's Eye was searching the land for the ring. It found you on the pad instead and lingered.
Bilbo has a title for this chapter: There and Back Again, Quite Quickly.
The eagles have been summoned. Not to rescue you. They just want to see it again.
fantasy_magic: Merlin lives backwards, so he's seen that fall coming for centuries. He still winced.
Conan drove his enemies before him. You got driven off a boulder well below your grade.
Hermione has a book on this. She's leaving it outside your door, bookmarked at chapter one.
Dumbledore says our choices show who we truly are. You chose to fall off that.
Voldemort loses to a teenager every school year. You're in his company now, briefly.
Rincewind's only real skill is falling off things and surviving. Welcome to the faculty.
Howl threw a full tantrum over bad hair dye. You're allowed one for this. It's comparably tragic.
Five points from your house, for the fall.
The Luggage has climbed better than that, and it's a box with legs.
The Sorting Hat would like to reconsider.
fantasy_worlds: Geralt's witcher senses are highlighting the start holds in red. Out of pity.
Link can scale any cliff in Hyrule on one tiny stamina wheel. What's your excuse?
Kratos tore down Olympus. You got torn down by something he'd use as a doorstop.
Fus Ro Dah is supposed to throw the enemy off the mountain, Dragonborn. Not you.
Yennefer watched the whole thing. She hasn't said a word. That's so much worse.
Ciri can open a portal to anywhere. You opened one straight to the pad.
Dandelion has a new hit: "The Fall of the Mid-Grade." The tavern is already singing along.
Roach can climb a sheer cliff by glitching into it. You couldn't glitch into that.
Vesemir has watched boys fail the Trial of the Grasses. This was somehow sadder.
Triss is pretending she didn't see that. Triss is a famously bad liar.
Tyrion demands a trial by combat on your behalf. He then looks at the boulder and withdraws the request.
A girl has no name. You do have a grade, though, and that boulder sits well below it, Arya says.
You know nothing, Jon Snow. And today you've got company, because neither does that climber.
Tormund climbed the Wall with an axe and a hangover. The Wall is slightly taller than that.
Paarthurnax has lived for thousands of years and can still be surprised. Thanks for that.
Lydia, sworn to carry your burdens, is now carrying your pride. It weighs nothing.
Zelda waited a hundred years for a hero. She can wait another ten minutes for you to top that.
Ganondorf is laughing in his tower. He didn't even have to send a Moblin.
Atreus asks if you're okay. Kratos tells him not to ask. That's how bad it looked.
An arrow to the knee would at least be an explanation.
superheroes: Deadpool: "Wow. And people said my movie had a weak second act."
Wolverine's healing factor can fix anything except whatever beta you just used.
Hulk confused. Hulk smash rock easy. Puny human lose to small rock.
Superman has X-ray vision and still can't find a reason you fell off that.
Doctor Strange viewed every possible future. You topped it in nearly all of them. Not this one.
He-Man says "I have the power." He checked, and apparently you don't.
Skeletor is doing the evil laugh at you. Skeletor. The man who loses every week.
Batman has a contingency plan for every hero. He's filed yours under "not needed."
Aquaman at least has the excuse of being out of water.
Ant-Man could shrink to fit those footholds. You just had to stand on them.
science_fiction: Darth Vader: 'I find your lack of grip disturbing.'
Han Solo did the Kessel Run in under twelve parsecs. You did about twelve centimetres.
R2-D2 lets out a sad descending whistle. You don't speak droid, but you understood that perfectly.
In space, no one can hear you scream. This is a climbing gym, though, and Ripley heard everything.
Spock: 'Fascinating.' He means it the way a doctor means it.
Red pill or blue pill? You took neither and fell off the start holds.
Renegade interrupt prompt appeared. You pressed it on yourself.
Stormtrooper accuracy, but for hand placement.
Captain's log: away team defeated by a boulder well below its rank. The Klingons are laughing.
Warthog flipped. That was the easy jump, Spartan.
gaming: Leap of faith attempted. Ezio found the hay cart. You found the cobblestones.
Desynchronized. Altair did not climb like that. The Animus is embarrassed on your behalf.
Mario could beat this level with the jump button broken. Luigi did, actually, while you were falling.
Sonic says 'You're too slow.' Fair, but you weren't on the wall long enough to be slow.
Solaire is still praising the sun. Just with his back to you, out of courtesy.
Malenia's waterfowl dance knocks people out of the air. You fell off without anyone dancing at all.
Siegward fell asleep halfway through your attempt. Honestly, the right call.
'Shaw!' says Hornet. Scholars of Hallownest translate this as 'that one was easier than your usual, bug.'
The Doom Slayer fights the armies of Hell. You lost to a plastic hold well below your grade. He is not writing that down.
Arthur Morgan had a plan: 'just climb the easier one.' It did not survive contact with the start holds.
Astarion: 'Darling, I've seen corpses with better grip. I've been one.'
Karlach keeps cheering, but her engine just made a sad little sputter.
Kim Kitsuragi writes something in his notebook, then shields it with his hand so you can't see.
Zagreus fell back into the Styx too. To be fair to him, he was fighting his father, not a mid-grade.
Critical failure on a check the DM only called for out of habit.
COMPOSURE [Trivial: Failed]. You are trying to look like you meant to fall. Nobody believes you, least of all you.
A Minecraft villager could have topped that. They don't even have hands.
YOU DIED. To the Asylum Demon, figuratively. That's the tutorial boss, in case you'd forgotten.
Classic Hollow Knight: dying in the starting area with all your Geo. Go fetch your shade, the walk is short.
The blue shell of boulders: it wasn't even the hard one, and it still got you.
anime: You got lost on a boulder with about six holds. Zoro is relieved. He's finally not the worst navigator here.
Levi watched you fall and asked who let you near his wall in those filthy shoes.
Vegeta laughed. Vegeta laughing is never a good sign, unless you're Goku.
Saitama has never lost a fight. You lost one to a boulder you've already outclimbed. He's actually interested now.
Kakashi did not look up from his book. He didn't need to. He heard the pad.
Armin had a plan. The plan assumed you'd hold the second hold.
Hange wants to study what went wrong. So far the findings are "everything" and "gravity".
Erwin gave the order to advance. You advanced directly downwards.
Mikasa did this one in her scarf, one-handed, on her way to save Eren.
Eren swore to wipe out every titan. Maybe start with this boulder. It's a lot smaller.
Goku's scouter reading came back strange. Either the scouter is broken or your feet are.
Naruto failed his academy exams three times, but he was eleven. What's your excuse?
Luffy would have stretched his arm straight to the top. You needed that arm and didn't have it.
Edward Elric reached above his level and lost a leg. You reached below your level and lost the plot.
Ryuk dropped his apple laughing. Ryuk does not drop apples.
That attempt had a flashback, an inner monologue and no top. Very authentic anime pacing.
The boulder didn't even need a power-up. It stayed in base form and won.
You said "next episode" so many times on this one that the boulder got its own spin-off.
Vegeta's pride would never let him fall off something below his level. Your pride seems fine with it.
The Survey Corps lost soldiers to fifteen-metre titans. You lost to a boulder you could warm up on. Erwin is reviewing your enlistment.
portal_science: GLaDOS has seen test subjects fall into acid with more dignity.
Wheatley says that was his fault. It wasn't, but it's sweet that he thinks he has that much influence.
Cave Johnson wants that fall analysed by the lab boys. Not for science. For the blooper reel.
Chell has fallen off things before. Into portals. On purpose.
Stack the Companion Cube under the top hold and it would have done better. You were less helpful than a box.
GLaDOS: "Interesting. You're much worse at this than your file says." She's updating your file.
Wheatley would like to suggest some new beta for this one. That's how you know it went badly.
Cave Johnson says failure is part of science. He also says this wasn't science.
Chell's long-fall boots exist so that she never has to land like that.
GLaDOS: "The next test is easier. Oh. You already failed the easy one."

general: Topped. Yes. And?
Logged. The database barely noticed.
Congratulations on climbing something you could climb ages ago. Steady.
Completed. The log is now slightly longer. That's the whole story.
That's a top. A top so routine it could have been an email.
You topped it. The wall didn't even get a chance to hold a grudge.
Noted, filed, already forgotten by everyone except this database.
Good to know you can still do that. Was there ever any doubt? No.
A clean top at a grade your best grade calls 'the lobby'.
Ticked. My eyebrows remain exactly where they were.
climbing_humour: Topped the warm-up. The pad didn't even notice you were there.
Sent. Not worth filming. Not even worth propping the phone up.
Logged. Even the beta sprayer couldn't find anything to explain.
That's a top on the grade you use to check whether your shoes still fit.
Done. Chalk used: one pinch. Excitement generated: also one pinch.
Topped. The setter made that one for the after-school club, but sure.
It was a jug ladder and you climbed a jug ladder. History will be silent.
Ticked. Nobody turned around. Nobody needed to.
A top on the circuit the kids in Crocs use to wind down.
Fine. Rest on the mat for twenty minutes if you like, but we both know you don't need to.
learning_persistence: Result confirmed. Again. The notebook is running out of ways to write 'yes, known'.
That wasn't an experiment. That was a demonstration.
Sample size: one more. Statistical significance: none.
The textbook already has this example worked out. Now you do too.
Progress chart unchanged. The pen has gone back in its cap.
Peer review: 'Correct. Next.'
Gravity is still working, and so are you, roughly as predicted.
This adds nothing new to the literature. It is, however, in the literature.
The lab notebook has filed this under 'already known' and turned the page.
Homework handed in. The teacher has not looked up.
mythology: Sisyphus finishes this one too. Every day. Forever.
Icarus would like it known he could also do that one, wings or not.
Odin saw it with one eye and decided not to involve the other.
Thor has walked up steeper hills than that to get to dinner.
Athena logged it under events. Not under achievements.
Loki tried to find something interesting to say about it and gave up.
Anubis weighed it. The scale did not move.
Sun Wukong was born from a rock. He has done that one since he was a rock.
Amaterasu did not get up for this. It's still dawn somewhere.
Anansi heard the story and asked where the rest of it was.
Poseidon checked the ocean. No waves were made.
Hermes has delivered the message. Nobody opened it.
Hades counts this as a stroll. He has those too.
Hercules does this one wearing a lion skin and a hangover.
Artemis aimed at it, then lowered the bow out of politeness.
Fenrir yawned. It was a wolf yawn, so it was large, but it was a yawn.
Zeus heard. He's continuing with his afternoon.
Recorded. The epic poets have been notified and declined.
Valhalla does not have a hall for this. It has a coat rack.
Yes. It stays on the wall. You were briefly on top of it. Moving on.
middle_earth: 'You shall pass,' says Gandalf, without looking up from his pipe. He was never going to stop anyone on that.
Gandalf brought fireworks to Bilbo's hundred and eleventh birthday. For this, he brought a match. Unlit.
Frodo has walked further than that to steal mushrooms.
Smaug did not wake up for that.
Samwise has done harder things carrying Frodo and the cooking pans. Still, well done for carrying only yourself.
Gollum looks at it, then at you. 'Not precious.' Back into the cave he goes.
Legolas didn't count that. Gimli did, then quietly crossed it out.
Gimli says it's a rock and you went up it. In Moria they'd call that a staircase.
Aragorn has not drawn his sword for this. He has not stood up.
Boromir confirms that one does, indeed, simply top that.
Pippin says he topped that in Bree after three pints. Nobody asked, but it's now on record.
Merry checks the menu. Topping this does not unlock a meal. Not even elevenses.
Elrond did not call a council for this. He sent a short note.
Galadriel looked in her mirror, saw this, and felt no need to look again.
Saruman hasn't even bothered to sneer. He has a tower to run.
Treebeard noticed you had finished before he noticed you had started.
The Balrog stays asleep in Moria. Nobody needs a wizard for that one.
Sauron's Eye sweeps over the gym without stopping. Mordor has no file on this.
Bilbo writes it in the margin of the Red Book, in small letters, next to the shopping list.
The Fellowship took this route on the way to the actual quest.
fantasy_magic: Merlin knew this would happen. It wasn't one of the things he bothered remembering.
Conan once punched a camel. That was more of an event.
Hermione did this one in her first week. While reading.
Dumbledore smiles at it kindly, the way he smiles at a nice pair of socks.
Voldemort heard. He has no comment. He has a snake to feed.
Rincewind ran past it without noticing. He runs past most things.
Howl's castle stepped over this on its way somewhere interesting.
A first-year charm. The kind that makes a feather lift slightly.
No points to your house. No points from it. Points remain.
The Librarian looked up from his book, said ook, and went back to the book.
fantasy_worlds: Geralt: "Hm." Then the other "Hm." That's the full review.
Link opened the chest. It contained one green rupee.
Kratos looked at the boulder, then at you, then walked off. Standard Kratos.
Dragonborn, you've shouted down dragons. You just cleared a level-one cave. The loot is a wooden plate.
Yennefer: "Yes. And?"
Ciri has seen many worlds. This was one of them.
Dandelion thought about writing a song about it, then wrote one about lunch instead.
Roach did that once while Geralt was meditating. Unprompted. Without a rider.
Vesemir logs it in the Kaer Morhen ledger, right below "cleaned the stables."
Triss nods politely, the way you nod at someone's holiday photos.
A Lannister always pays his debts, and Tyrion has checked. He owes you nothing for that one.
Arya watched. Arya blinked. That was the reaction.
Jon Snow notes that it was climbed, then goes back to staring north.
Tormund doesn't even laugh. He just keeps eating his chicken.
Paarthurnax is meditating on more important matters. Which, compared to that, is all of them.
Lydia stands by, sworn to carry your burdens. There was no burden.
Zelda adds a line to her journal: "Observed a climber climbing a small rock." She underlines nothing.
Ganondorf didn't look up from his organ.
Atreus asks if it counts. Kratos: "It counts." A long pause. "Barely."
The Wild Hunt doesn't care. The Night King doesn't care. The Daedra don't care. Topped, though.
superheroes: Deadpool reads your log aloud and pauses for laughs. There are none.
Wolverine doesn't look up from his beer.
Hulk see. Hulk not care. Hulk go back to nap.
Superman saved forty people before lunch. You did a warm-up. Noted.
Doctor Strange saw this coming in every timeline. Still not worth watching.
He-Man doesn't even raise the sword. It's not that kind of moment.
Skeletor: "Oh good, a climber climbed. Riveting." Back to scheming.
Batman logs it in the Batcomputer, under "routine."
The Flash did that one while you were chalking up. Anyway, done.
Aquaman asks if there were any fish on it. There weren't. He leaves.
science_fiction: Darth Vader breathes. That's it. That's the response.
Han Solo: 'Great, kid. Don't get cocky.' He's already walking back to the Falcon.
R2-D2 beeps once. Flat. The beep he uses for opening doors.
Ripley has watched people survive xenomorphs. You survived an easy boulder. She is not asking for an autograph.
Spock notes that the outcome was entirely predictable and moves on to the next line of the report.
You walked through the lobby. No bullet time required.
You scanned a planet. No resources detected. Codex entry updated.
Halo on Easy. The Grunts surrendered on sight. Mission complete.
Successfully ordered tea from the replicator. Earl Grey. Lukewarm.
The Death Star exhaust port was two metres wide. This boulder was a barn door. Hit.
gaming: Ezio climbs this every morning to buy bread.
Altair did this one without his left ring finger. Historically accurate.
World 1-1. Mario cleared it. Luigi cleared it. The Goomba could probably clear it.
Sonic ran past this one. He didn't notice it was a boulder.
Solaire nods politely, the way you nod at someone else's holiday photos.
Malenia, Blade of Miquella, has not looked up from her sword. She will not.
Siegward napped through it. He didn't miss anything.
Hornet is saving 'Shaw!' for something harder. You get a flat 'hm'.
The Doom Slayer does not rip and tear trash mobs. He just walks through them. As you just did.
Arthur Morgan had a plan. It was this. It was a low bar, and the plan cleared it.
Astarion, already bored: 'And for your next trick, darling, will you walk up some stairs?'
Karlach gives you a high-five at exactly room temperature.
Kim Kitsuragi writes 'Topped.' He does not underline it.
Zagreus clears rooms like this on his way to breakfast with Cerberus.
DC 5. Passed. The DM has already moved on to the next scene.
PERCEPTION [Trivial: Success]. You notice this was well within your grade. So does everyone else.
Minecraft, Peaceful mode. No creepers, no danger, one very safe block placed.
Firelink Shrine is technically also a level. Congratulations on the shrine.
Achievement unlocked: Pressed Start. 99.8% of players have this one.
You successfully mounted your horse. The Red Dead tutorial prompt disappears.
anime: Saitama after one punch: "OK." Saitama after your top: also "OK."
Levi inspected it. Clean enough. Next.
Kakashi read two pages while you climbed it. Short chapter.
Nobody's hair turned gold for that one. Vegeta checked.
Goku sensed a power level. Then he sensed lunch and lost interest.
Ryuk yawned. Shinigami get bored easily, and this was an apple-free episode.
Zoro found the top. To be fair, it was the only direction available.
Hange logged it as a control group. Nothing unexpected occurred. Hange is disappointed.
Erwin does not send scouts into territory you already own.
Luffy is already asking what's for dinner. That's how long the climb held his attention.
Mikasa saw it. Mikasa said nothing. Mikasa says nothing about most things.
Armin had no plan for this one. It did not need a plan.
Eren did not scream. It did not merit a scream.
Naruto says believe it. Easy. Nobody doubted it.
Equivalent exchange: you gave it nothing, it gave you a log entry. Edward Elric finds the transaction valid and boring.
Topped. No flashback, no theme song, no next-episode preview.

That wall was shorter than a fifteen-metre titan's ankle. You got over it. Yes.

portal_science: GLaDOS: "You topped it. Here is your applause." There is no applause.

Chell would not have bothered firing a portal for this one.

Chell's face did not change. To be fair, it rarely does. For this, it really didn't.
